study.research_question: Can GEODE at revision 8a5c26454 complete one infrastructure-valid tau2 rollout in each of the airline, retail, and telecom domains while preserving native evaluation and trajectory evidence?
study.research_gap: GEODE has no public tau2 1.0.1 artifact spanning all three canonical domains under one frozen model and runtime contract.
study.hypothesis: GEODE will receive a nonzero native tau2 reward in at least one of the three frozen domain rollouts, and all infrastructure-valid rollouts will emit native result and trajectory artifacts.

primary_metric.name: mean_native_tau2_reward
primary_metric.aggregation: Arithmetic mean of the three suite-native task rewards, one frozen task and one attempt per domain; no retry replaces a valid zero.

study.decision_rule: Report per-domain and mean native reward descriptively. Accept the data release only if all three selected attempts have suite-native result and trajectory evidence; this diagnostic pilot cannot promote a release.
study.invalidation_rule: Mark a rollout invalid for route, quota, timeout before a native result, simulator, harness, evaluator, or trajectory failure. Preserve a suite-native reward of zero as a valid semantic outcome and do not retry it.
study.analysis_plan: Run the ordered airline, retail, and telecom examples separately with one trial and seed 20260825. Select the sole attempt, report native reward components, steps, token and wall-time evidence where available, and publish only privacy-reviewed synthetic interactions.

environment.reset_strategy: The pinned tau2 harness constructs a fresh domain environment and applies the task initial_state for every simulation; reset isolation is attested by preflight-receipt.json.

execution.command_redacted: Run python -m evolve.crucible.tau2_geode_agent once per frozen domain/task with --model gpt-5.6-terra --provider openai --source subscription --effort max --user geode_user --user-llm gpt-5.5 --user-provider openai --user-source subscription --user-effort high --num-tasks 1 --num-trials 1 --max-concurrency 1 --seed 20260825 --max-retries 0 --max-steps 20 --timeout 900 and fresh domain-specific --save-to IDs.

budget.unit: three agent rollouts plus three simulated-user conversations

privacy.redaction_boundary: Publish synthetic tau2 task and conversation evidence only after secret and absolute-path scans. Exclude credentials, environment variables, local paths, and any model-provider account metadata; label all names and identifiers as benchmark fixtures.
